subject: Approval request: ClearSail combined concession for POC
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Approval request: ClearSail combined concession for POC

Team —

Quick summary: ClearSail (seed-stage, Series A close expected Q4) is running a month-long POC for their summarization + retrieval pipeline. They've been heavy on tokens during integration (spikes to 200k tokens/day) and are pausing progress unless we make a one-time concession. They're in discussions with two competitors; closing this POC cleanly unlocks an expected $90k ARR conversion in 12 months.

Ask (one-time exec exception):
- $25,000 in free hosted credits applied to the POC (one-use, expires in 60 days)
- 30% discount off list for first 3 months of a committed plan if they sign a 6-month minimum within 30 days

Why: Close timeline is tight (customer says infra spend is the blocker). They're technically aligned and product-fit looks high. Marketing may highlight as a launch partner for our embeddings guide.

Risks / guardrails:
- Credits expire after POC window (60 days) and are non-recurring
- Discount requires a signed commitment (we should capture in DocuSign)
- Finance needs to confirm revenue recognition, legal to review SLA/terms

I'm asking for explicit exec sign-off so I can send final terms to ClearSail and generate the DocuSign. If approved, I'll attach the concession summary and M A P for legal/finance intake.

Requested by EOD today given customer cadence.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: ClearSail combined concession for POC

Monica —

Sounds reasonable to me given the ARR potential. A couple of small asks before finalizing:
- Shift some of the concession from a deep discount to credits (keeps initial revenue profile higher). Maybe $20k credits + 20% for first 3 months instead of 30%.
- Add a clause that credits are only redeemable on hosted API and not transferable.
- Finance link: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/finance/exception-guidelines — please paste the final figures there so FP&A can sign off.

If Marissa's comfortable, I'm OK to greenlight.

— Aditya
VP Sales Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: ClearSail combined concession for POC

Approved with edits.

Final approved concession (exec exception):
- One-time credits: $20,000 (hosted API only, expire 60 days from issue)
- Commercial discount: 20% off list for the first 3 months after signing, contingent on a minimum 6-month commitment signed within 30 days
- Require M A P and DocuSign capture of the commitment and billing cadence

Conditions: legal to review standard SLA/terms; finance to confirm GAAP treatment. If legal flags anything material, pull me in.

Monica, send the offer to ClearSail with the three attachments (concession summary, proposed M A P, DocuSign quote) and copy me. I'll approve signature routing.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@clearsail.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@clearsail.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: ClearSail POC concession: $20k credits + 20% intro discount (next steps)
Attachments: concession_summary.pdf (application/pdf), proposed_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), docusign-quote.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Samir / Alyssa —

Thanks again for the demo today. Per our conversation and internal approval, Redwood is prepared to offer a one-time concession to support ClearSail's POC finish line:

- $20,000 in hosted API credits (applies to usage during the POC window only; expires 60 days from issuance)
- 20% discount on list for the first 3 months after signing, provided a minimum 6-month paid commitment is signed within 30 days

I've attached a short concession summary and a proposed mutual action plan outlining milestones, success criteria, and timing. I've also attached the DocuSign quote; if the terms look good, sign the DocuSign and we'll route for final approval on our side.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the attached concession and MAP, reply with any redlines by EOD Thursday
2) We execute DocuSign within 48 hours of agreement
3) Credits are applied immediately upon completion of DocuSign and invoice setup

If you prefer, I can loop in legal to review the exact SLA language before signature.

Thanks — excited to help ClearSail get over the integration hump.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Samir Patel <samir@clearsail.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@clearsail.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-21T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearSail POC concession: $20k credits + 20% intro discount (next steps)

Monica —

Thanks — this is great news. We appreciate the flexibility. We'll review the concession_summary and MAP this morning and route the DocuSign internally. One quick ask from legal: can we get the SLA appendix before executing? If so, send over the standard SLA and we'll aim to have the signed DocuSign within 48 hours.

On acceptance, can the credits be applied as a single line item on the first invoice? That'd help our accounting team.

Best,
Samir
Co-Founder, ClearSail AI
